blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover core parsing, CRC and length recovery, truncation, non-finite values, zero and negative eigenvalues, and row-major math, but do not test several documented requirements such as invalid dimensions, nonzero reserved bytes, partial headers, maximum-length boundaries, or all malformed-stream cases.

deterministic_tests: The verifier setup performs apt and curl network downloads and installs tools at test time, so test execution depends on external network availability and mutable remote resources.

valid_failure_modes: A capable solution can fail because the verifier requires external apt and curl access during setup, an environmental failure unrelated to the repair task; several malformed-input requirements are also not concretely exercised.
advice: pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the mutable python:3.13-slim-bookworm image tag rather than a digest or fully pinned image; runtime package versions are therefore not completely pinned.
